body:
Simple Feature Plugin
Simple Feature Plugin is a lightweight utility designed to add fun minigames and essential shortcuts to your server without sacrificing performance. It is built to be extremely resource-efficient (low RAM usage).

### 📜 Features & Commands ###
- /duel: Instantly teleport players to your designated PvP world. It’s a 
lightweight alternative to complex warp systems.
 
- /gacha: A simple built-in minigame where players can roll for a chance to win between $1 - $100. Perfect for keeping your community engaged.
  
- /test: A quick diagnostic command to ensure the plugin is responding.
  
- /smfp reload: Easily reload your configuration changes in-game.

### 📦 Requirements ###
To use all features correctly, please ensure you have the following plugins installed:
- Vault & an Economy plugin (for /gacha rewards).
Multiverse-Core (for the 
- /pvp teleport function.
- LuckPerms (to manage permissions like group.maindev).

### 🛠️ How to Install ###
Download the latest .jar file.
Drop it into your server's plugins folder.
Restart your server.
Configure your rewards and world names in config.yml.

I am open to suggestions! Please leave a comment or message if you have ideas on how I can improve this project.
